name: lookup-no-wrap
why: keys past the last point map to the last point instead of wrapping

name: lookup-linear-scan
why: lookup walks the points one by one

edits.old: auto it = std::lower_bound(points_.begin(), points_.end(), h, [](const Point& p, std::uint64_t value) { return p.hash < value; });
edits.new:
auto it = points_.begin();
        while (it != points_.end() && it->hash < h) ++it;

name: add-sorts-everything
why: every add_node re-sorts the whole ring

name: add-forgets-to-merge
why: the new points are appended and never merged

name: merge-wrong-boundary
why: the merge boundary is the wrong size

name: all-points-identical
why: every virtual node of a server sits at the same place

name: weight-ignored
why: weights do not change the number of points

name: weight-zero-accepted
why: a node of weight 0 is accepted

name: duplicate-add-accepted
why: adding an existing node adds its points again

name: remove-leaves-points
why: removing a node leaves its points behind

edits.old: points_.erase(std::remove_if(points_.begin(), points_.end(), [node](const Point& p) { return p.node == node; }), points_.end());

name: remove-leaves-node
why: removing a node leaves it in the node table

name: remove-scrambles-order
why: removal uses partition, which does not keep the order

edits.old: points_.erase(std::remove_if(points_.begin(), points_.end(), [node](const Point& p) { return p.node == node; }), points_.end());
edits.new: points_.erase(std::partition(points_.begin(), points_.end(), [node](const Point& p) { return p.node != node; }), points_.end());

name: remove-always-true
why: removing an unknown node reports success

edits.old:
if (it == nodes_.end()) return false;
        const std::string* node = &it->first;
edits.new:
if (it == nodes_.end()) return true;
        const std::string* node = &it->first;

name: replicas-repeat-nodes
why: lookup_n may return the same node twice

name: replicas-start-at-zero
why: lookup_n starts at the first point, not at the key

name: replicas-skip-the-owner
why: lookup_n starts one point after the key

name: nodes-unsorted
why: nodes() lists the names in table order

name: zero-vnodes-allowed
why: a ring with 0 virtual nodes has no points

name: lookup-copies-the-key
why: lookup copies the key into a std::string

name: empty-ring-not-checked
why: lookup on an empty ring reads a point that is not there

name: contains-wrong
why: contains() is true for nodes that were never added and false for added ones

edits.old: bool contains(std::string_view name) const { return nodes_.find(std::string(name)) != nodes_.end(); }
edits.new: bool contains(std::string_view name) const { return nodes_.find(std::string(name)) == nodes_.end(); }
